definition.assertion: Compile and execute actual LastStandProgression C# with pinned Mono/Roslyn. Inject storage outcomes at its transaction boundary without replacing game logic; assert exact state and failed-write immutability.

done_when: All six named C#-executed cases pass after retained RED, including write-success/readback-failure reconciliation.
One single-record save contract has no silent memory fallback, corrupt-state reset, account/backend integration or new dependency.
task.rollback: Revert only the task-owned playable-loop changes; retain prior art scenes, existing MechanicsShopModel, historical evidence and native approval records. Do not erase or migrate a player save during rollback.
steps: Write the six named compiled-C# cases first using the existing shop harness pattern; retain behavioral RED for reward duplication, cap/price math, malformed state and failed/uncertain save transitions.

Implement LastStandProgression as pure validated state transitions: level 0..3, cannon damage 20+10*level, cost level+1, zero initial state, monotonic reserved run IDs, one pending ordinary-defeat reward, one-record claim and purchase candidates. Do not reuse or change fixture-only MechanicsShopModel pricing.

Implement LastStandStore plus the tiny WebGL localStorage get/set/exact-readback bridge. Validate the complete version-1 shape and IDs, handle missing/corrupt/unsupported data explicitly, preserve committed state on failure and reconcile a matching candidate after uncertain writes. Only a successful save unlocks economic transitions. Editor adapter exists only for real Editor checks and is never a successful fallback for blocked Web persistence.
Run the declared focused command; maps-to TDD obligations AC-01 reward/idempotence, AC-02 transaction/failure and AC-03 price/cap/next-run snapshot.
